title: GigaClaw run handoff (v1)
description: What one agent leaves behind for the next one: what it produced, what it assumed, what it still owns, and what remains open. Frozen at v1 alongside the verdict contract: additive changes only. An unreadable handoff is treated as no handoff.

schemaVersion.description: Handoff contract version. Bumped only for breaking changes.

agent.description: Slug of the agent that produced this run's work.

runId.description: The run that produced this handoff. Makes the chain auditable across restarts.

summary.description: One line the next agent reads first: what changed and what it now needs to do.

inputs.description: What this run consumed. Usually the previous handoff's outputs.

outputs.description: What this run produced, with digests where the next agent must verify them.

ownedFiles.description: Workspace-relative paths or globs this run wrote or claims. Consumed by the file-ownership lease layer to serialize overlapping runs - overstating scope blocks other agents, understating it corrupts their work.

assumptions.description: Decisions taken without confirmation. The next agent inherits them or challenges them.

openLoops.description: Known-unfinished work. Empty means the run claims it left nothing dangling.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The ticket's criteria as this run understands them, each marked met or not.

nextRole.description: Agent slug this work is handed to. Null when the run hands back to the owner.

ref.description: Same discipline as verdict evidence: path = workspace-relative, hash = sha256:<64 hex>, link = absolute https URL.

blocking.description: True when the next agent cannot finish without this being resolved.

evidenceRef.description: Ref of an outputs entry that demonstrates it. Required for a met criterion.
